description: Keep generated project photos in a gallery and create or edit the next image from the panel or chat. People profiles use labeled reference sheets and can build missing face, body, and detail views for reuse across models. Nano Banana 2, 2.1, Pro, and Muse Image use paid fal.ai or kie.ai API keys; Muse Image requires fal.ai. The chat Send form remembers the model, frame, and size, with 2K as the default size; the interface supports English and Russian, and Env Catalog can hold the keys.
